item.title: PEP After Sexual Assault: Testing and Emotional Care

item.title: Where to Get PEP in Bangkok and Pattaya
item.description: Potential HIV exposure within 72 hours? Learn where to seek PEP in Bangkok and Pattaya, what to prepare, and how SWING can help.

item.title: Condom Broke or Slipped? What to Do in the First 24 Hours
item.description: If a condom breaks or slips, don’t blame yourself. Learn the urgent steps for HIV PEP, emergency contraception, and testing.

item.title: PrEP and Transgender Hormones: Can They Be Used Together?
item.description: PrEP can generally be used with gender-affirming hormones. Do not stop either medicine on your own; seek trans-affirming clinical support.

item.title: Why PrEP Follow-Up Every 3 Months Matters
item.description: PrEP care includes regular HIV, kidney and STI screening. Follow-up every three months helps keep prevention safe and suited to your needs.
